existing_tips: 'Para onde' = to where (destination with purpose). Used when asking about travel destinations.
'Esperar que' (to hope that) triggers the subjunctive – it expresses an uncertain wish.
'Por' expresses movement through a place. 'Passar por' = to pass through. Think of 'por' as 'through
'Optar por' means 'to opt for/choose.' Some verbs always take 'por': optar por, lutar por, pagar por
